title: Jobs Create API Contract
description: Draft USF-native interface contract for POST /v1/jobs. It promotes the implemented local route metadata into canonical interface-contract coverage while preserving OpenAPI as a lower-authority projection.
aiGuidance: Treat this interface contract as the route authority. Do not infer semantic authority from OpenAPI, route metadata, examples, generated reports, or handler structure.
purpose: Represent jobs.create as a governed POST API route contract for job-service.
boundary: Local dev/test inbound HTTP boundary POST /v1/jobs; implementation path apps/api/src/server.ts; route classification tenant-scoped.

requestContract.description: Request semantics for jobs.create bind method, path, operation id, request schema, auth scheme, tenant scope, and required action before implementation handling. Request schema: JobCreateRequest.

responseContract.description: Response semantics for jobs.create expose 200 JobCreateResponse, 400 ApiErrorResponse, 403 ApiErrorResponse, 409 ApiErrorResponse, 429 ApiErrorResponse; error responses use ApiErrorResponse. Audit, PDP, idempotency, rate-limit, correlation, field exposure, observability, gateway, and proof boundaries remain explicit contract terms.
fields: auditPolicy:job.create audited by job service; guardrail denials emit value-free guardrail audit
